content:
[task from parent]

Read /work/ch/in3.txt (lines: index<TAB>claim). Each claim is a word/definition statement, possibly negated (never, not, no, 'in no context', 'Not a single'). For each line decide whether the claim is TRUE or FALSE as a statement about English word meanings (first decide if the definition really fits the word; negation flips it). Think carefully per line; do not use heuristics on word overlap. Write /work/ch/out3.txt with one line per input: index<TAB>T or F. Then message parent 'done'.
